lecons.title: Agricultural tools and their care
lecons.summary: Agricultural tools are the tools used to work in the farm: the cutlass, the hoe, the spade, the rake. Some of them are made to dig. A tool that is cleaned, dried, oiled and hung in its place lasts for years. A tool left dirty in the grass is lost.

lecons.title: Preparing the farm for planting
lecons.summary: Before anything grows, the farm is made ready. You clear it, you dig or till the soil, you add manure, you water it if there is no rain, and only then do you plant the seed or the seedling. The order matters: each step prepares the next one.
